decisions.statement: A branch created is named for a change or a merge or a project and for a number.
The number tells a merge branch from the merge queue's own ref.
A branch already there is updated and deleted freely.
main is never created and never deleted here.
main only advances onto a commit an admitted branch already holds.
A branch pushed in the same transaction counts as holding that commit.
One ref refused refuses the whole push.
No push gets past this hook.

definition: a push refused unless it names a change branch or moves main onto one
